very loose and useless macro observations (from my lifetime)

>tech always ends up being deflationary

>china's involvement always ends up being deflationary

>betting that "china + AI" won't be deflationary, idk

>American patriotism reliably takes a backseat to "man they just sell us shit 90% cheaper, I got kids to feed, etc" 

>every single dip in FANG/Mag7/current stupid @$$ name for this corrupt oligarchy, has been a dip to buy, year after year, since 2010, and bears always look dumb as fuck calling tops

>the reason is that these companies control the entire universe and investors wake up and say, "wtf else am I supposed to own, fucking SAP? Every other company sucks ass" 

>dont lose sight of the fact that META/GOOGL pay $250M every single quarter in "fees/fines" (aka graft) to the point where I don't even think its non-recurring anymore, or, its the first non-recurring item that has gotten taken out of adj EBITDA for 342 straight quarters

>if mu and sndk went to 0 nothing would change

>if AI capex gets cut, imagine how bullish the "zomg exponential FCF ramp" narrative could get...50% FCF CAGR trading at 8x EBITDA (but on EBITDA less capex its 125x)

>Warsh will get extorted into cutting rates as soon as he invents a new "inflation" definition (CPI is now 98% LG TV's and 2% bananas - alpha fruit right there - deflationary af, trendsetter)

>gun to my head the AI shit deflates (no idea when), the SPX shrugs it off, and marches higher

>the existence of werewolves in london = zevon's paradox
